newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares recover, trend depends on New York.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares recover, trend depends on New York.

text.p: 1616 GMT - Portuguese shares recovered from a weak start and the indices ended flat. As international markets limited losses, local stocks inched higher before the close. Dealers said that fears over possible U.S. and German rate hikes could weigh on markets, including Lisbon, in the coming sessions. Liquidity in the cash market was a relatively light 10 billion escudos.

* Utility EDP-Electricidade de Portugal dropped to 3,060 escudos, just above support at 3,000, in anticipation of the admission next month of 60 million new shares held by employees, small investors and emigrants, dealers said.

* Builder Engil hit a new high on optimism over its plans to develop a new "economic group" with Edifer, they added. "The markets were quite negative early today, but the national indices recovered nearly all their losses, as some stocks received a push before the close," one operator said. "Tomorrow's opening will depend on the close in New York today and the early reaction of European markets."
